name: Security
author: Austin Case
description: Firewall state, network exposure, and package integrity in the Omarchy bar

barWidget.description: Correlates listening sockets against ufw rules, watches network hygiene, and tracks package advisories and file integrity. Works with nothing installed.

schema.label: Show a count of warnings next to the icon
Treat the collector's data as stale after this many seconds
Colour for warnings (blank uses a theme-neutral amber)
List loopback-only listeners in the exposure table
Notify when a check newly fails (warnings never notify)
Fetch the Arch security advisory database (the only network request this makes)
